metadata.title: Rustic Country Portrait with Slab Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A sepia-toned rustic portrait featuring a central figure in western attire framed by a window with heavy, distressed slab-serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast color photography is required
clean minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-full shot of a man in a cowboy hat and dark shirt leaning against a rustic window frame. The entire image is processed with a warm, desaturated sepia filter and heavy grain. Large, distressed white slab-serif text is positioned on the left, overlapping the dark interior wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the vertical lines of a weathered window
High contrast between the dark interior wall and the bright, hazy exterior view
Typography anchored to the dark negative space on the left
Warm sepia tones unifying the subject, background, and text
coreInvariants: Sepia or monochromatic warm color palette
Heavy slab-serif typography with distressed textures
Western-style wardrobe including a cowboy hat
Visible film grain and weathered surface textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is right-of-center, standing at full height, leaning against a window frame that occupies the middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and cowboy hat serve as the primary focal point, balanced by the large text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face, down the arm to the large typography, then across the window frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the far left provide a high-contrast foundation for the white text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal shadows in the interior
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and cream highlights in the window light
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; values range from crushed blacks to blown-out highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, brown, cream, and black

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with minimal modulation
Distressed, eroded edges to simulate woodblock printing or weathering
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly irregular baselines for a hand-stamped feel
Internal grit and speckle textures within the letterforms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text uses a smaller, more condensed version of the primary slab serif or a typewriter-style face.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule or underline for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and slab-serif structure.
Classic western feel with strong serifs.
Captures the industrial/weathered look if distressed manually.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of a man in a cowboy hat leaning against a rustic wooden window frame in a dark room. The light from the window should be hazy and bright, creating a high-contrast silhouette effect on the interior side. Apply heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, distressed slab-serif text in off-white on the left side of the image over the dark wall area. Ensure the text has eroded edges and a gritty texture.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/monochrome?
Is the typography a heavy, distressed slab serif?
Is the subject wearing a cowboy hat?
Is there a clear contrast between the dark interior and bright window?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent sepia grading across text and image
Ensure grain is visible in both highlights and shadows
Confirm text is legible despite distress
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Western Portrait + Distressed Slab Serif + Sepia Toning + High Contrast Window Framing
